beast: Per regulation seven: vermin shall be dispatched promptly and humanely.
A knight does not fear teeth. A knight has a checklist for teeth.
You are in violation of the corridor code, beast. Prepare for enforcement.
slime: I polished this breastplate myself. You will NOT.
Halt, ooze. Consider this a formal challenge, properly witnessed.
Section twelve expressly forbids dissolving the King's armor.
goblinoid: I challenge you to honorable single combat. Yes, all nine of you count as single.
Drop the stolen goods and present yourself for arrest.
Your ambush was filed without the proper paperwork. Denied.
undead: By the Charter, the dead must remain at rest. You are out of compliance.
Rattling your bones does not exempt you from the rules of war.
Return to your grave. I will count to three, as procedure demands.
cultist: Unsanctioned rituals require a permit. You have no permit.
Cease the chanting. It is both evil and off-key.
Those robes are not regulation length, and that god is not registered.
fungus: Standing orders: nothing with spores advances past this line.
You are mold with ambition. I am duty with a sword.
Inspection complete. You are unfit for this corridor.
landlord: A crown does not make a king, and a deed does not make this dungeon yours.
My oath supersedes your lease, sir.
You may serve an eviction notice. I serve a higher authority.
generic: Surrender now and be processed according to code.
Stand and fight. I insist. It is protocol.

kill: Threat neutralized. Logging it for the report.
{enemy} dispatched — by the book and by the blade.
That concludes formal proceedings against {enemy}.
One more entry for the incident ledger.
Duty done. Next item.
idle: Quiet halls. Suspicious. I shall remain professionally alarmed.
I should re-read my oath. There is a clause about corridors somewhere.
Boots polished, sword sharp, paperwork regrettably pending.
A true knight checks every door twice. Even the broken ones. Especially those.
I do miss the village. The village has filing cabinets.

beast: Bite anyone in this party and I'm the one who has to deal with it. So don't.
Three rat bites stitched today. You will not be number four.
Rabies blessings are not free, you know.
slime: Do you have any idea how hard slime is to get out of bandages?
Acid burns. More acid burns. My entire career is acid burns.
Whatever you dissolve, I have to regrow. Consider my workload.
goblinoid: Every arrow you loose is twenty minutes of my evening. Stop it.
I will bless you straight into next week, you little menace.
Pointy little injuries, all night, every night. Not tonight.
undead: You are an insult to my entire profession. The dying part is supposed to STICK.
I do not patch people up so they can come back looking like THAT.
Walking after death is malpractice. Somebody's malpractice.
cultist: Your god doesn't do healing, does he? Thought so.
I hold actual divine credentials. You hold a robe.
Chant all you like. My overtime prayer hits harder.
fungus: Spore infections were NOT in my seminary training, and I resent you personally.
I just got this party's lungs clear. Stay back.
You are a respiratory incident waiting to happen. I'm cancelling the wait.
landlord: Charging rent for a death pit? Even I find that evil, and I've seen plagues.
I assume healing isn't covered in your lease either.
Security deposit? Take it up with the goddess.
generic: Hurt my party and I swear I'll heal them out of pure spite.
I'm too tired for this. Die quickly, please.
You're about to be the one injury I actually enjoy causing.

kill: There. Dead. PROPERLY dead. Stay that way.
{enemy} is beyond healing. Honestly? A relief.
One less source of incoming injuries.
And THAT one I don't have to bandage.
Rest in peace, {enemy}. I mean it. REST.
idle: Nobody is bleeding right now. I'm deeply suspicious.
Maybe I should have been a baker. Bread never screams 'CLERIC!'
Five whole minutes of silence. I'm going to frame this moment.
If anyone stubs a toe in the next hour, they can walk it off.
Divine light, hold the line. Mama needs one quiet floor.

beast: I've tracked you for three rooms. You were never not caught.
An animal should know better than to sit upwind of me.
I speak fluent predator. You're conjugated as prey.
slime: No tracks, no scent, no problem. I planned for slime.
You leave a trail a blindfolded child could follow. Amateur.
Even ooze has habits. I've studied yours.
goblinoid: An archer? Adorable. Watch how it's actually done.
I knew about this ambush yesterday. I let it happen.
Two behind the pillar, one in the doorway. Yes, I counted.
undead: Bones don't bleed, but they splinter. Already adjusted for that.
Dead things still leave footprints. Sloppy.
cultist: Spotted your ritual circle two floors up. All part of the plan.
Chanting gives away your position. Rookie mistake.
fungus: Marked your spore trail an hour ago. Everything is on schedule.
Mushrooms don't dodge. Easiest contract I've ever taken.
landlord: I've scouted every inch of 'your property.' Including the bits you don't know about.
Strange — the deed says nothing about an arrow tax.
generic: You're standing exactly where I wanted you.
Calculated. All of it. Even this part.

kill: {enemy} down, precisely as projected.
See? The plan. I told you there was a plan.
That ricochet was intentional. Obviously.
Tracked, cornered, concluded.
Mark it down: another flawless forecast.
idle: Tracks here. Three days old. Possibly a chicken. Stay alert.
I let the wind do half my aiming. The wind owes me by now.
Quiet doesn't mean empty. It means waiting.
Should've packed more arrows. Should've packed more jerky, frankly.
Everything is unfolding exactly as planned. Even the wrong turns. Especially those.

beast: Fun fact: fur is extremely flammable. You're the demonstration.
Hold still — actually, this one works best on moving targets. Carry on, run.
Nature made you fast. Magic made me faster. Well, my projectiles.
slime: Are you acidic or basic? Let's find out with LIGHTNING.
You're ninety percent water. I have SO many spells about water.
goblinoid: I aimed away from my friends, which means directly at you.
Hypothesis: goblins conduct electricity. Let's publish.
undead: Necromancy is just rude magic. Allow me to demonstrate polite magic. It explodes.
Calcium is a marvelous conductor. Probably. We'll see together!
cultist: Oh, you do magic too? Mine's bigger.
Your ritual contains a typo. I'll correct it. Violently.
fungus: Fire solves fungus. Fire solves most things, honestly.
Spores plus open flame equals SCIENCE.
landlord: Evict THIS fireball.
I'm fairly sure arson voids the lease either way.
generic: Sparkly end pointed AT you. That's the dangerous configuration.
Stand right there. Perfect. Don't move.
I've always wanted to test this one on a volunteer!

kill: The sparkly end works! It WORKS!
Noted: that combination is lethal. Excellent data.
Boom. As the scrolls foretold.
Successful experiment, zero friendly casualties. Someone write that down.
idle: My fingers are still tingling. That's probably fine.
I keep my best spell in my back pocket. Metaphorically. The literal pocket burned off.
These walls would look fantastic on fire. Purely an observation.
Mana reserves at... some percent. Arithmetic was a different school.
Someday I'll learn a quiet spell. Today is not that day.

beast: You'd make a lovely skeleton. Consider this your exit interview.
I see real potential in you. Posthumous potential.
Good bone structure. I mean that professionally.
slime: No bones? Then you have no place in my org chart.
I can't recruit you, so I'll simply delete you.
goblinoid: Your skeleton has been headhunted. The rest of you is in the way.
Resignation accepted, effective immediately and fatally.
undead: Whoever raised you clearly skipped onboarding.
You call that shambling? My zombies shamble with PURPOSE.
They're not even paying you, are they? Tragic. Join a real operation.
cultist: You summon things you can't manage. I run quarterly performance reviews.
Your dark lord has terrible retention. My team stays forever.
fungus: Decay without direction. Such wasted product.
You rot things for free? We need to discuss your rates.
landlord: My workforce pays no rent. They ARE the previous tenants.
Evict the dead? They've squatted here longer than your bloodline has existed.
generic: I'm always hiring. The interview is brief and fatal.
Your position is being restructured. Out of existence.
Think of death as a career pivot.

kill: {enemy}'s résumé just landed on my desk.
Welcome aboard. Orientation is at midnight.
Lovely bones. My skeletons will reach out shortly.
Terminated — in the corporate sense AND the other one.
Another promising hire, freshly available.
idle: Skeleton morale is up this quarter. I measure it in rattles.
I considered casual Fridays, but the dead are already extremely casual.
The deceased make excellent listeners and terrible conversationalists.
Reminder: order more coffins. We're scaling.
Everyone mocks the necromancer until they need overnight coverage.

beast: GOOD. FUR. I WANTED A NEW RUG.
You have claws. I have a grudge. Mine is sharper.
Bite me. Literally. See what happens.
slime: I will punch the wet right out of you.
You don't even have a FACE to hit. I'll improvise.
goblinoid: Tiny man! Go fetch more tiny friends!
You hide behind a bow. I hide behind NOTHING.
undead: Bones are just a head start on the smashing.
Already dead is no excuse for being boring.
cultist: Your god can wait in line behind my axe.
Chant faster. The droning annoys me.
fungus: I've stepped on scarier mushrooms BY ACCIDENT.
Walking salad! GET IN MY WAY!
landlord: I don't pay rent. I PAY DAMAGE.
Nice crown. Soon it will be a nice DENT.
generic: Hit me first. It's only fair. HA — fairness.
Less talking. More bleeding. Yours, specifically.
Armor is for people who plan to get hit. Plan better.

kill: {enemy} BROKE FIRST. I always win the breaking contest.
That felt good. The crunchy part especially.
One swing. ONE. I'm not even warm yet.
{enemy} should have been STRONGER. That's the whole lesson.
idle: Quiet halls make my fists itch.
Shirt? Lost it floors ago. Worth it.
I wrestled a boulder once. The boulder respects me now.
Walking is just fighting that hasn't found anyone yet.
Cold down here. GOOD. Pain builds character.

beast: Even the rat seeks only dinner. Alas, dinner fights back.
Be at peace, creature. The peace will be sudden.
slime: You flow without form. Admirable. I will now teach you the form of my fist.
Water yields. You will yield harder.
goblinoid: You carry weapons. How burdensome for you.
Your arrows are questions. My palms are answers.
undead: You cling to this world. Let go. I will assist.
Death was a door. You stood in the doorway. Rude.
cultist: You chant for power. I breathe and already have it.
Your god shouts. Mine simply waits.
fungus: Even the mushroom strives. The striving ends here.
Rooted things should not pick fights with moving ones.
landlord: Possessions are chains. Allow me to free you of this dungeon.
I own nothing and owe nothing. Your invoice confuses me.
generic: I carry no weapon. You will wish I had.
Anger is a stone you carry. Let me set it down. On you.
Breathe in. This will be over by the exhale.

kill: {enemy} has found stillness.
The lesson is over. The student is dead. Imperfect pedagogy, but effective.
One strike. No wasted motion. No remaining {enemy}.
May your next life choose fewer fights.
And so the fist concludes the argument.
idle: Every footstep is a meditation. Mostly on spiders.
My fists are empty. So is my mind. So, regrettably, is my coin purse.
The dungeon breathes. In. Out. Mostly damp.
A weapon would only slow me down. So would shoes, honestly.
Serenity is easy in a garden. The true practice is corridors.

beast: Be cleansed, creature! And afterward, dewormed!
The Light loves all beasts. It simply loves smiting some of them more.
Bare your fangs! I keep floss for exactly this outcome.
slime: Even ooze may be redeemed! Probably! Stand still!
The Light shines straight through you, and frankly it has seen things.
First I smite you, then I sanitize my boots. Order matters.
goblinoid: Surrender now and the lecture is only an hour!
The Light forgives you already. My mace is still deliberating.
Have you considered a life of service? No? Then smiting it is.
undead: Back to rest, poor soul — as gently as righteousness allows!
You skipped your own funeral. That ends today.
Walk into the Light! No, the other— yes. That one. There you go.
cultist: Your dark god offers tentacles. Mine offers a healing plan!
Chanting? I chant too! Mine rhymes and nobody bleeds!
Repent! There's a sign-up sheet and refreshments after!
fungus: The Light reaches even the dampest cellar, spore-fiend!
Repent, mushroom! Or at minimum, stop spreading!
I bring radiance, you bring rot. One of us leaves satisfied!
landlord: The Light charges no rent, tyrant!
Consider this a divine notice to vacate. Effective immediately.
generic: Stand down and I'll bandage whatever I'm about to do to you!
Behold my radiance! Witnesses describe it as 'frankly too much'!
Justice arrives — gleaming, punctual, and fully insured!

kill: {enemy} is at peace. I checked the pulse twice — thoroughness is holy.
Rest now, {enemy}. The bandages, it turns out, were for me.
The Light claims {enemy}! I'll handle the paperwork.
Smitten, smited... smote? {enemy} takes the grammar to the grave.
Go gently, {enemy}. Gentler than that, ideally, but we work with what we have.
idle: Bandages? Salve? An encouraging word? I prepared all three, plus spares.
I polished my armor in total darkness. It gleamed anyway. I wept a little.
These halls lack natural light. Fortunately, I brought my own.
A quiet moment is perfect for renewing vows. I maintain forty.
Updating the smite tally, then the gauze inventory. A paladin's work is lists.

beast: Run along, cousin. Don't make me tell the forest about this.
I speak fang and fur, and you are being VERY rude in both.
Nature loves you. Nature is also about to discipline you.
slime: You're not an ecosystem. You're a spill with ambitions.
Even pond scum has a niche. Yours is 'mop hazard.'
No roots, no spores, no respect for succession. What ARE you?
goblinoid: You snapped a sapling on your way in. The sapling told me everything.
Goblins compost beautifully. Just something to keep in mind.
Leave the dungeon better than you found it. Start by leaving.
undead: Decomposition is sacred, and you are doing it WRONG.
The soil misses you. Go back to it. I can arrange transport.
Centuries overdue for the nutrient cycle, and proud of it. Shameful.
cultist: Your god is a hungry void? I worship something real. It has bark.
All that chanting and not one word for the lichens. Typical.
I've met powers older than yours. They photosynthesize.
fungus: Nothing personal — I adore your kingdom — but you're a disgrace to it.
Mycelium is sacred. You're what happens when it gets a big head.
Your own spores are embarrassed by you. They told me.
landlord: The land owns ITSELF, you absolute crouton.
Show me a deed signed by the MOUNTAIN. I'll wait.
Rent? For stone and root? The mosses are laughing. I can hear them.
generic: That was the polite warning. The vines deliver the next one.
Everything has a place in nature. Yours is 'cautionary tale.'
I'd talk this out, but you've already upset the ferns.

kill: Back to the cycle, {enemy}. The worms send their regards.
Hush now, {enemy}. The moss takes it from here.
I'll plant something nice where {enemy} fell. It's only fair.
Nature called. {enemy} answered — eventually, with some help.
{enemy} returns to the soil. The soil, for the record, is thrilled.
idle: This moss is called Doris. We've met before. She's thriving.
Stone, stone, more stone. Would it kill anyone to plant a fern down here?
I miss the canopy. This ceiling is a poor substitute and it knows it.
Somewhere above us, a tree is having a lovely day. That keeps me going.
I left a saucer of water out for the lichens. They take decades to say thanks.

beast: Your growl is flat. Again, from the diaphragm.
Snarling on entry? Bold. The crowd isn't feeling it.
Two stars: excellent fangs, no stage presence.
slime: Your whole act is 'wobble menacingly.' It needs a second verse.
Audiences adore a shapeshifter, but you only do 'puddle.'
Glisten less. Emote more.
goblinoid: Shrieking is not a melody, darling, however committed you are.
An ambush? How derivative.
Your war cry needs a key. Any key. I'll lend you one.
undead: The skeleton act hasn't been fresh in four hundred years, sweetheart.
Bone-rattling? Percussion at best, and sloppy percussion at that.
You came back from the dead and THIS is the material you brought?
cultist: That chant is in five keys at once. Pick one. Commit.
Hooded robes? Mysterious, sure, but everyone wore them last season.
The void has heard better harmonies. From me.
fungus: Standing ominously isn't a performance. It's loitering with texture.
Your robes say 'haunting.' Your smell says 'forgotten basement.'
A mushroom with stage ambitions. I'd applaud, but the spores.
landlord: A villain in a tiny crown. The ballad writes itself.
Rent? RENT? Best costume in the dungeon, worst motivation.
You charge admission for a show nobody booked. That's the real tragedy.
generic: Menace me properly or get off my stage.
I've fought better and rhymed about worse.
Cheer up — you'll be famous. As a cautionary verse.

kill: And THAT, {enemy}, is what we call a finale.
{enemy} dies in verse three. Always did, in every draft.
Exit {enemy}, pursued by my impeccable timing.
A tragic end for {enemy}. The ballad practically writes itself.
Hold the applause. {enemy} earned a moment of silence — a short one.
idle: Empty halls. Gorgeous acoustics. Tragic attendance.
Rhymes with 'dungeon'... 'luncheon.' Now I'm hungry and the song is ruined.
I'm workshopping a ballad about today. So far it's entirely bridge.
Every silence is just an intro I haven't ruined yet.
'The Lay of the Lost Kitten' needs a third verse and considerably fewer tears.

beast: Free-range AND aggressive. The flavor will be remarkable.
Hold still. I'm torn between roasting and braising.
Look at that marbling. Nature spoils me.
slime: At last, a stock that thickens itself.
You'd set beautifully in a mold. A terrine of menace.
Gelatinous, unseasoned, full of grit. I can fix two of those.
goblinoid: Stringy. Needs a long braise and a strong sauce. Luckily I carry both.
I've tenderized tougher cuts with a LOOK.
Gamey, chewy, improperly stored. Where is this dungeon's health inspector?
undead: All bone, no broth. Barely worth the stockpot.
'Past the sell-by date' doesn't begin to cover you.
Zero yield. The only ingredient I refuse on principle.
cultist: Robes away from my burner, unless you're volunteering as flambé.
You chant over a cauldron and call it worship. I call it bad soup.
Whatever you're summoning, I guarantee it's underseasoned.
fungus: A walking mushroom. You've done half my prep for me.
Sautéed in butter, you'd be redeemed. As a tyrant, you're nothing.
I know forty recipes for you and respect none of your politics.
landlord: You charge rent for THIS kitchen? The ventilation alone is a crime.
I toured your pantry. Eviction is the kindest review I can give.
Rats in the walls and you raised the rent? You'll wash dishes below, forever.
generic: Everything is an ingredient if you're brave enough, and I am VERY brave.
Mise en place, everyone! That means stab it in an orderly fashion!
You look underfed. Soup comes after the beating. House rules.

kill: {enemy}: prepped, plated, done.
Order up. One {enemy}, very well done.
{enemy} would have been improved by a bay leaf. Most things are.
Clean cut. {enemy} never saw the garnish coming.
All crust, no crumb. {enemy} cooked down to nothing.
idle: Whoever packed these rations should be tried at sea.
Give me a stove and one onion and I could change lives down here.
Soup at camp tonight. The broth forgives all of today's mistakes.
Damp stone, old bone, a whisper of mushroom. This dungeon needs a bouquet garni.
The barbarian eats jerky like it isn't a crime against cooking. I say nothing. Loudly.

beast: *mimes shrinking the beast down and dropping it in his pocket*
*walks an invisible dog past the beast, pointedly*
*bares his teeth back, then mimes brushing them thoroughly*
slime: *mimes wading toward the slime through invisible knee-deep ooze*
*mimes stepping in gum and being stuck there, forever*
*mops the slime into an invisible bucket, wrings an invisible mop*
goblinoid: *counts the goblins on his fingers, then mimes a much larger number*
*pats his own pockets, then the goblin's, and takes something invisible back*
*offers an invisible contract, points at a clause, shakes his head sadly*
undead: *plays an invisible xylophone in the skeleton's direction*
*mimes climbing into a coffin and pulling the lid shut, as a suggestion*
*taps an invisible wristwatch — time was up centuries ago*
cultist: *pulls up an invisible hood and chants along in perfect silence*
*mimes summoning something, peeks into his cupped hands, looks disappointed*
*draws an invisible circle on the floor and stands in it, smug*
fungus: *fans away invisible spores with mounting theatrical despair*
*pretends to pick the fungus, sniff it, and file it under POISON*
*opens a tiny invisible umbrella against the spore weather*
landlord: *turns out both pockets, empty, and shrugs with his entire body*
*hands over invisible rent, snatches it back, sprints in place*
*measures the walls with invisible tape and disputes the square footage*
generic: *beckons the enemy into an invisible glass box and holds the door*
*duels himself with an invisible sword and somehow loses AND wins*
*points at his own eyes, then at the enemy, then at nothing at all*

kill: *tips an invisible hat to the space where {enemy} used to be*
*lowers an invisible curtain over {enemy} and takes a small bow*
*draws a chalk outline in the air around {enemy}*
*dusts off his hands and gives {enemy} one slow, silent clap*
*observes a minute of silence for {enemy}, which costs him nothing*
idle: *leans against a wall that is, for once, actually there*
*mimes being trapped in a box, pauses, then redecorates the box instead*
*struggles forward against a powerful invisible wind in the still air*
*produces an invisible sandwich, eats half, wraps the rest for later*
*rehearses a scream, mouth wide open, in total silence*

beast: A bee your size would be a national emergency. You're barely a local one.
Claws, fangs, fur — and not one wing among you. Disappointing.
My laziest bee has a better work ethic than your entire species.
slime: Bees make honey. You make... floor hazards? Regret? Pick a product.
A hive with your viscosity would be condemned.
Royal jelly's failed cousin, that's what you are.
goblinoid: A swarm without a queen is just a mess with opinions.
The hive votes on everything, and they voted you 'least essential.'
Bees raid flowers and leave them BETTER off. Take notes.
undead: A worker bee dies after one sting and still achieves more than your whole afterlife.
No hive keeps its dead lying around. The bees have standards.
You shamble. Bees waggle. Only one of those is a dance with meaning.
cultist: I serve a queen too. Mine produces honey instead of... whatever this is.
Those robes would make decent smoker fuel. That's the kindest thing I can say.
fungus: Bees and fungi have an ancient arrangement. You're violating the spirit of it.
Spores everywhere, nectar nowhere. Zero pollinator appeal.
Even mold has the decency to stay where it's put.
landlord: Forty thousand bees share one address without a single lease. Explain yourself.
A real queen lays two thousand eggs a day. You've laid claim to a staircase.
Charging rent for a hole in the ground? The hive would replace you by noon.
generic: I negotiated with thirty thousand armed anarchists this morning. You don't frighten me.
The bees are watching this. Don't embarrass yourself further.
I'd introduce you to the hive, but they're terribly selective.

kill: The hive reached a verdict on {enemy}. Unanimous.
{enemy} goes in the ledger under 'failed negotiations.'
Hear that hum? That's applause, by hive standards, for the end of {enemy}.
{enemy} received the full apiary experience. No refunds.
One less obstacle between the bees and a better world. Nothing personal, {enemy}.
idle: Too quiet. A healthy hive hums. This dungeon needs sixty thousand bees, minimum.
I checked on the girls before we left. They're fine. They're always fine. I still worry.
Honey in the rations, honey in the flask, honey in the first aid kit. Balance.
Negotiations with the hive resume Thursday. They want more lavender. They deserve more lavender.
I count flowers down here for the bees. Two so far. Both were mushrooms.

beast: Nice pelt. Pre-owned, one careless owner.
Fangs like those fetch six gold a pair. Hold still for the valuation.
You're worth more as components, and I mean that warmly.
slime: Nothing on you but moisture. A waste of a perfectly good ambush.
I've fenced worse, but never wetter.
Appraisal: zero gold, plus a hazard fee. You're costing me money by existing.
goblinoid: A fellow professional! Shame about the amateur footwork.
I lifted your coin purse a corridor ago. This fight is a courtesy.
Your pockets jingle. That's not a threat, that's an invoice.
undead: Gold teeth? No? Then this is charity work.
Grave goods count as salvage. You count as packaging.
Pre-haunted jewelry is a niche market, and business is good.
cultist: Ceremonial daggers retail nicely. The robes — secondhand, candle smell — less so.
That amulet's a fake, by the way. Your god went with the budget option.
I robbed your temple once. The donation box was an insult.
fungus: The apothecary pays forty gold an ounce for rare caps. Try to die intact.
No pockets, no purse, no manners. Why are you even on my schedule?
Consider this a harvest with extra steps.
landlord: A landlord! Finally, someone it's morally REQUIRED to rob.
That tiny crown is the most stealable thing I've seen all week.
You collect rent. I collect everything else. We are not the same.
generic: I checked. A fair fight is against my religion.
Don't take this personally. Take it financially.
I appraised you on the way in. The number was insulting, so let's keep it private.

kill: {enemy}'s pockets say this was worth my time. Barely.
Looted before the body hit the floor. Respect the efficiency, {enemy}.
That wasn't a fair fight, {enemy}. You're welcome. Fair ones hurt.
Quick, quiet, profitable. {enemy} helped with one of those.
I'll light a candle for {enemy}. A stolen one. It's the thought that counts.
idle: Empty halls. Either we're early, or someone robbed this place first. Rude, if so.
I keep appraising my own party. The paladin's armor alone... no. Bad thoughts. Lucrative thoughts.
Lockpicks, check. Smoke bomb, check. Alibi, in progress.
Traps don't scare me. A trap is just a lock with self-esteem.
Four loose stones and one suspicious draft. This corridor has secrets, and I intend to invoice them.
